exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.setup: Lie on a flat bench with eyes under the bar. Plant feet firmly. Grip slightly wider than shoulder width and unrack with straight wrists.
form_cues: Pull shoulder blades down and back.
Keep a small natural arch.
Lower the bar to the lower chest.
Keep forearms near vertical.
Press up and slightly back without bouncing.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.setup: Sit with dumbbells on thighs, then kick them into position as you lie back.
form_cues: Keep shoulder blades retracted.
Lower until elbows are slightly below the torso if comfortable.
Keep wrists stacked over elbows.
Press without clanking the dumbbells together.

exercises.name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
exercises.setup: Set bench to roughly 20 to 35 degrees. Position eyes under the bar and plant feet.
form_cues: Keep shoulder blades pinned back.
Lower bar to upper chest.
Avoid flaring elbows straight out.
Press up while maintaining contact with the bench.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.setup: Set bench to roughly 20 to 35 degrees. Bring dumbbells to shoulder level.
form_cues: Use a controlled descent.
Keep elbows slightly tucked.
Press the dumbbells up over the upper chest rather than toward the face.

exercises.name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
exercises.setup: Secure legs in the decline bench and position the bar over the lower chest.
form_cues: Keep shoulders retracted.
Lower under control to the lower chest or upper abdomen.
Press without bouncing.

exercises.name: Decline Dumbbell Press
exercises.setup: Secure legs before bringing dumbbells into position.
form_cues: Lower with control and keep wrists stacked.
Press upward while keeping the ribcage controlled.

exercises.name: Machine Chest Press
exercises.setup: Adjust seat so handles line up around mid chest. Set the back pad so shoulder blades remain supported.
form_cues: Keep wrists neutral.
Press smoothly without locking out aggressively.
Do not let shoulders roll forward at the bottom.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Bench Press
exercises.setup: Position bench so the fixed bar path reaches the lower to mid chest.
form_cues: Retract shoulders and keep feet planted.
Lower with control.
Avoid forcing an uncomfortable bar path.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.setup: Start in a high plank with hands just outside shoulder width.
form_cues: Keep body in a straight line.
Lower chest between the hands.
Keep elbows about 30 to 60 degrees from the torso.
Push the floor away.

exercises.name: Wide Push-Up
exercises.setup: Place hands wider than normal push-up width.
form_cues: Keep ribs and hips aligned.
Do not let elbows flare excessively.
Lower with control and press through the palms.

exercises.name: Diamond Push-Up
exercises.setup: Place hands close together under the sternum, forming a narrow base.
form_cues: Keep elbows close to the torso.
Maintain a rigid plank.
Stop if wrist discomfort develops.

exercises.name: Decline Push-Up
exercises.setup: Place feet on an elevated stable surface and hands on the floor.
form_cues: Keep hips from sagging.
Lower chest toward the floor.
Maintain a neutral neck and press evenly.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up
exercises.setup: Place hands on a stable elevated surface and feet on the floor.
form_cues: Maintain a straight body line.
Lower chest toward the edge of the surface and press away.

exercises.name: Weighted Push-Up
exercises.setup: Use a snug weight vest or have a partner place a plate high on the back, not the lower spine.
form_cues: Use standard push-up mechanics.
Keep the added load secure and avoid excessive lumbar extension.

exercises.name: Archer Push-Up
exercises.setup: Use a very wide hand position. Shift most of your bodyweight toward one arm while the other arm stays more extended.
form_cues: Keep the working elbow tracking naturally.
Move side to side under control.
Do not twist the hips.

exercises.name: Chest Dip
exercises.setup: Support yourself on parallel bars and lean the torso slightly forward.
form_cues: Lower only as far as the shoulders tolerate.
Keep shoulders down away from ears.
Press through the bars without swinging.

exercises.name: Pec Deck Fly
exercises.setup: Adjust seat so elbows or handles align with mid chest.
form_cues: Keep a slight elbow bend.
Bring arms together by squeezing the chest.
Do not let shoulders roll forward aggressively.

exercises.name: Cable Fly
exercises.setup: Set pulleys around chest height and step forward into a split stance.
form_cues: Keep elbows softly bent.
Bring hands together in an arc.
Keep shoulders down and control the stretch.

exercises.name: Low-to-High Cable Fly
exercises.setup: Set pulleys low and stand slightly forward of the stacks.
form_cues: Sweep hands upward and inward toward upper chest or chin level.
Keep ribs down and avoid shrugging.

exercises.name: High-to-Low Cable Fly
exercises.setup: Set pulleys above shoulder height.
form_cues: Sweep hands down and inward toward the lower chest or upper abdomen.
Keep elbows softly bent and torso stable.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Chest Press
exercises.setup: Anchor band securely behind you at chest height.
form_cues: Press straight forward while keeping ribs stacked.
Return slowly and keep the band under control.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Fly
exercises.setup: Anchor the band behind you around chest height.
form_cues: With soft elbows, bring arms together in front of the chest.
Do not over-stretch the shoulders behind the body.

exercises.name: Svend Press
exercises.setup: Hold one or two plates squeezed together in front of the chest.
form_cues: Maintain inward pressure on the plates while pressing forward.
Keep shoulders down and ribs controlled.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Pullover
exercises.setup: Lie across or along a bench and hold one dumbbell above the chest with both hands.
form_cues: Keep elbows slightly bent.
Lower behind the head only as far as shoulder mobility allows.
Pull back over the chest without overextending the spine.

exercises.name: Conventional Deadlift
exercises.setup: Stand with midfoot under the bar. Grip just outside the legs. Bring shins to the bar while keeping the bar over midfoot.
form_cues: Brace hard.
Keep the bar close.
Push the floor away and stand tall.
Do not yank the bar or overlean backward at lockout.

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift
exercises.setup: Take a wide stance with toes turned out. Grip the bar inside the knees.
form_cues: Brace and wedge hips close to the bar.
Push knees out in line with toes.
Keep the bar close and lock out by standing tall.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.setup: Start standing with the bar at hip height.
form_cues: Push hips back with soft knees.
Keep the bar close to the legs.
Stop when hamstrings are deeply stretched without rounding the back.
Drive hips forward to stand.

exercises.name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
exercises.setup: Hinge at the hips until torso is roughly 30 to 60 degrees from horizontal.
form_cues: Brace the trunk.
Row bar toward lower ribs or upper abdomen.
Keep elbows controlled and avoid jerking the torso.

exercises.name: Pendlay Row
exercises.setup: Set the bar on the floor and hinge until the torso is close to parallel.
form_cues: Brace before each rep.
Pull explosively to lower chest or upper abdomen, then return the bar to the floor without bouncing.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.setup: Support one hand and knee or one hand on a bench. Keep the working foot planted.
form_cues: Row the dumbbell toward the hip.
Keep shoulders square and avoid twisting the torso.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
exercises.setup: Lie chest-down on an incline bench with dumbbells hanging beneath you.
form_cues: Pull elbows back and slightly out based on target.
Keep chest on the pad and avoid shrugging.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.setup: Sit tall with knees slightly bent and handle attached to low cable.
form_cues: Pull handle toward lower ribs.
Keep torso mostly still.
Do not over-reach by rounding the low back.

exercises.name: T-Bar Row
exercises.setup: Straddle the bar or use a chest-supported T-bar machine. Hinge if unsupported.
form_cues: Row toward the chest or upper abdomen.
Keep elbows controlled and spine neutral.

exercises.name: Landmine Row
exercises.setup: Anchor one end of a barbell. Straddle the bar and use a V-handle or grasp the bar sleeve.
form_cues: Hinge and brace.
Pull toward the lower chest.
Keep the bar close and avoid excessive torso movement.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.setup: Adjust thigh pad snugly and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders.
form_cues: Pull elbows down toward the ribs.
Bring bar toward upper chest.
Avoid leaning far back or pulling behind the neck.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown
exercises.setup: Attach a close neutral or underhand handle and secure thighs.
form_cues: Pull handle toward upper chest while driving elbows down.
Control the stretch overhead.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Lat Pulldown
exercises.setup: Use a high cable and kneel or sit so the arm starts overhead.
form_cues: Drive elbow toward the hip.
Keep torso from rotating and avoid shrugging.

exercises.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
exercises.setup: Set cable high and stand far enough back for tension at the top.
form_cues: Keep elbows nearly straight.
Pull from overhead down toward thighs by using the lats.
Avoid turning it into a triceps pressdown.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.setup: Hang from a bar with hands slightly wider than shoulders.
form_cues: Start by pulling shoulders down.
Drive elbows toward the ribs.
Bring upper chest toward the bar without swinging.

exercises.name: Chin-Up
exercises.setup: Use a shoulder-width underhand grip.
form_cues: Keep ribs controlled.
Pull chest upward while driving elbows down.
Lower to full control.

exercises.name: Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
exercises.setup: Grip parallel handles and begin from a controlled hang.
form_cues: Pull shoulders down and elbows toward the sides.
Avoid kicking or excessive arching.

exercises.name: Assisted Pull-Up
equipment: Assisted pull-up machine or resistance band
exercises.setup: Use a machine counterweight or a safely secured band.
form_cues: Use the same mechanics as a normal pull-up.
Avoid relying on momentum.

exercises.name: Inverted Row
equipment: Bar in rack or suspension trainer
exercises.setup: Set a bar around waist height and hang beneath it with body straight.
form_cues: Pull chest to the bar while squeezing shoulder blades.
Keep hips from sagging.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.setup: Set cable around face height and grip rope with thumbs pointing back.
form_cues: Pull rope toward forehead while rotating hands apart.
Keep shoulders down and avoid arching the low back.

exercises.name: Barbell Shrug
exercises.setup: Hold bar at thigh level with arms straight.
form_cues: Elevate shoulders straight up toward ears.
Pause briefly.
Do not roll the shoulders.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shrug
exercises.setup: Hold dumbbells at sides with neutral grip.
form_cues: Shrug straight upward and control the lowering phase.
Avoid bending elbows.

exercises.name: Back Extension
exercises.setup: Set pad just below the hip crease so hips can hinge freely.
form_cues: Hinge at the hips, not through the low back.
Rise until body forms a straight line.
Do not hyperextend.

exercises.name: Reverse Hyperextension
equipment: Reverse hyper machine or sturdy bench
exercises.setup: Position hips at the edge of the pad with legs hanging.
form_cues: Raise legs by extending the hips.
Stop around body alignment and avoid throwing the legs upward.

exercises.name: Good Morning
exercises.setup: Place bar securely across upper back as for a squat. Use a moderate stance.
form_cues: Brace and push hips back with soft knees.
Keep spine neutral.
Return by driving hips forward.

exercises.name: Superman Hold
exercises.setup: Lie face down with arms overhead or by the sides.
form_cues: Lift chest and legs slightly while keeping neck neutral.
Use a modest range and avoid forcing lumbar extension.

exercises.name: Barbell Overhead Press
exercises.setup: Start with bar at upper chest, wrists stacked, and feet about hip to shoulder width.
form_cues: Brace glutes and abs.
Move head slightly back as bar passes, then bring head through at lockout.
Do not lean excessively backward.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.setup: Start dumbbells around shoulder level, seated or standing.
form_cues: Press overhead while keeping ribs down.
Keep wrists over elbows and avoid excessive arching.

exercises.name: Arnold Press
exercises.setup: Start with palms facing you and dumbbells near chin level.
form_cues: Rotate elbows outward as you press overhead.
Use a smooth path rather than forcing rotation.

exercises.name: Machine Shoulder Press
exercises.setup: Adjust seat so handles begin near shoulder height.
form_cues: Press overhead without shrugging excessively.
Keep back against pad and control the return.

exercises.name: Landmine Press
exercises.setup: Hold the end of the bar at shoulder height with one or both hands.
form_cues: Press up and forward along the bar path.
Keep ribs stacked and avoid twisting.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.setup: Stand tall with dumbbells at sides and elbows softly bent.
form_cues: Raise arms out to the sides until around shoulder height.
Lead with elbows.
Avoid swinging or shrugging.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
exercises.setup: Set pulley low. Stand side-on or slightly in front of the cable.
form_cues: Raise arm out to the side with a soft elbow.
Keep torso still and control the return.

exercises.name: Machine Lateral Raise
exercises.setup: Adjust seat so machine pivot aligns with shoulder joint.
form_cues: Drive elbows outward into pads.
Stop near shoulder height and avoid shrugging.

exercises.name: Front Raise
exercises.setup: Stand tall with weight in front of thighs.
form_cues: Raise to about shoulder height while keeping ribs down.
Avoid using momentum.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly
exercises.setup: Hinge forward or lie chest-supported on an incline bench.
form_cues: Sweep arms outward with soft elbows.
Focus on moving from the shoulders and avoid shrugging.

exercises.name: Reverse Pec Deck
exercises.setup: Adjust seat so handles line up with shoulders.
form_cues: Pull arms apart while keeping chest against pad.
Avoid excessive low-back arch.

exercises.name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
exercises.setup: Cross cable handles in front of you at shoulder height.
form_cues: Pull arms outward with soft elbows.
Keep shoulders down and torso still.

exercises.name: Upright Row
exercises.setup: Use a grip around shoulder width or slightly wider.
form_cues: Pull elbows upward only to a comfortable height.
Do not force elbows far above shoulders if it causes impingement.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Y-Raise
exercises.setup: Use very light weights. Stand hinged or lie chest-down on an incline bench.
form_cues: Raise arms diagonally into a Y.
Keep thumbs up and shoulders away from ears.

exercises.name: Scaption Raise
exercises.setup: Hold light dumbbells with thumbs slightly up.
form_cues: Raise arms about 30 degrees forward from directly out to the sides.
Stop near shoulder height.

exercises.name: External Rotation Cable
exercises.setup: Set cable around elbow height. Keep elbow bent 90 degrees and pinned to side.
form_cues: Rotate forearm outward without letting elbow drift.
Use light resistance and controlled motion.

exercises.name: Band External Rotation
exercises.setup: Anchor band at elbow height. Bend elbow to 90 degrees and keep it close to ribs.
form_cues: Rotate hand outward while upper arm stays still.
Move slowly.

exercises.name: Wall Slide
exercises.setup: Stand with back or forearms against a wall.
form_cues: Slide arms upward while keeping ribs controlled.
Reach slightly at the top without shrugging.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
exercises.setup: Stand tall with underhand grip around shoulder width.
form_cues: Keep elbows near sides.
Curl without swinging the torso.
Lower fully under control.

exercises.name: EZ-Bar Curl
exercises.setup: Grip angled portions of the bar comfortably.
form_cues: Keep wrists neutral and elbows mostly stationary.
Avoid leaning back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
exercises.setup: Hold dumbbells at sides with palms forward or rotate into supination.
form_cues: Curl while keeping upper arms still.
Squeeze at the top and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Alternating Dumbbell Curl
exercises.setup: Hold one dumbbell in each hand.
form_cues: Curl one side at a time without rotating the torso.
Fully control each lowering phase.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.setup: Hold dumbbells with palms facing inward.
form_cues: Curl while keeping neutral grip.
Keep elbows near sides and avoid swinging.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
exercises.setup: Set bench around 45 to 60 degrees and let arms hang behind the torso.
form_cues: Keep shoulders back.
Curl without moving elbows forward excessively.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl
exercises.setup: Set upper arms fully on the preacher pad.
form_cues: Curl without lifting upper arms off the pad.
Do not slam into full elbow extension at the bottom.

exercises.name: Cable Curl
exercises.setup: Set pulley low and stand tall.
form_cues: Keep elbows close to sides.
Curl smoothly and resist the cable on the way down.

exercises.name: Bayesian Cable Curl
exercises.setup: Set cable low and stand facing away so the arm starts slightly behind the body.
form_cues: Keep shoulder extended and curl without letting elbow drift forward.

exercises.name: Spider Curl
exercises.setup: Lie chest-down on an incline bench with arms hanging.
form_cues: Curl while upper arms stay pointed down.
Avoid lifting elbows toward the ceiling.

exercises.name: Concentration Curl
exercises.setup: Sit and brace the upper arm against the inside of the thigh.
form_cues: Curl slowly and squeeze at the top.
Keep the upper arm fixed.

exercises.name: Reverse Curl
exercises.setup: Use an overhand grip with wrists straight.
form_cues: Curl without letting wrists collapse.
Keep elbows near sides.

exercises.name: Cable Triceps Pressdown
exercises.setup: Set pulley high and stand close to the stack.
form_cues: Pin elbows near sides.
Extend forearms downward.
Avoid leaning bodyweight onto the handle.

exercises.name: Rope Pressdown
exercises.setup: Attach rope to high cable.
form_cues: Extend elbows fully while separating rope ends slightly.
Keep shoulders stable.

exercises.name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
exercises.setup: Face away from a cable set low or mid height and bring rope behind head.
form_cues: Keep elbows pointing forward.
Extend arms without arching the low back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension
exercises.setup: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands or one hand.
form_cues: Keep elbows relatively narrow.
Lower behind head under control and extend without flaring excessively.

exercises.name: Skull Crusher
exercises.setup: Lie on bench with arms extended above shoulders.
form_cues: Bend elbows to lower bar toward forehead or slightly behind head.
Keep upper arms relatively fixed.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
exercises.setup: Use a grip around shoulder width rather than extremely narrow.
form_cues: Keep wrists stacked.
Lower bar to lower chest with elbows tucked moderately.
Press without bouncing.

exercises.name: Bench Dip
exercises.setup: Place hands on a stable bench behind you and feet on the floor.
form_cues: Keep shoulders down and lower only as far as comfortable.
Avoid sinking deeply if shoulders feel stressed.

exercises.name: Parallel-Bar Dip
exercises.setup: Keep torso more upright than a chest-focused dip.
form_cues: Lower with elbows tracking back.
Press to lockout while keeping shoulders controlled.

exercises.name: Triceps Kickback
exercises.setup: Hinge forward and keep upper arm parallel or close to parallel with torso.
form_cues: Extend elbow until arm is straight.
Keep upper arm stationary.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Cable Pressdown
exercises.setup: Set high cable and stand square.
form_cues: Keep elbow by side.
Extend smoothly and avoid rotating the torso.

exercises.name: Wrist Curl
exercises.setup: Rest forearms on thighs or bench with palms up and wrists hanging off edge.
form_cues: Curl only at the wrists.
Use controlled range and avoid bouncing.

exercises.name: Reverse Wrist Curl
exercises.setup: Rest forearms supported with palms down.
form_cues: Extend wrists upward through a comfortable range.
Use light weight.

exercises.name: Farmer Carry
exercises.setup: Pick up weights with a safe deadlift pattern and stand tall.
form_cues: Walk with short controlled steps.
Keep ribs stacked and shoulders down.
Do not let weights swing.

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry
exercises.setup: Hold one heavy weight at your side.
form_cues: Walk without leaning toward or away from the weight.
Keep torso upright.

exercises.name: Plate Pinch Hold
exercises.setup: Pinch smooth-sided plates together between fingers and thumb.
form_cues: Stand tall and hold securely.
Keep plates away from feet in case grip fails.

exercises.name: Dead Hang
exercises.setup: Hang from a secure bar with hands around shoulder width.
form_cues: Maintain active shoulder position if passive hanging is uncomfortable.
Avoid swinging.

exercises.name: Towel Hang
exercises.setup: Loop a strong towel over a pull-up bar and grip each end.
form_cues: Hang under control.
Keep towel secure and stop before grip fails unexpectedly.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.setup: Set bar across upper traps or rear delts, brace, and step out into a stable stance.
form_cues: Sit down between the hips while knees track over toes.
Keep whole foot planted.
Maintain a braced torso and drive up through midfoot.

exercises.name: Front Squat
exercises.setup: Rack bar on front delts using clean grip or cross-arm grip.
form_cues: Keep elbows high and torso upright.
Let knees travel forward naturally.
Keep heels planted.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.setup: Hold weight close to chest with both hands.
form_cues: Sit down between knees.
Keep chest tall, feet planted, and knees tracking with toes.

exercises.name: Hack Squat
exercises.setup: Place shoulders and back against pads and feet on platform.
form_cues: Lower under control with knees tracking over toes.
Keep hips and back supported.
Do not lock knees aggressively.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.setup: Set feet about shoulder width on platform and adjust seat so lower back stays against pad.
form_cues: Lower until hips remain firmly supported.
Press through full foot.
Avoid locking knees hard.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.setup: Place rear foot on a bench and front foot far enough forward for balance.
form_cues: Drop the rear knee toward the floor.
Keep front foot planted.
Allow front knee to travel naturally over toes.

exercises.name: Split Squat
exercises.setup: Take a staggered stance with both feet remaining planted.
form_cues: Lower straight down.
Keep front foot flat and torso controlled.
Push through the front leg.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
exercises.setup: Stand tall with space to move forward.
form_cues: Step far enough to stay balanced.
Lower rear knee toward floor.
Push through the lead foot and continue forward.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
exercises.setup: Stand tall and step one foot backward.
form_cues: Lower until both knees bend comfortably.
Keep most pressure through the front foot and return to standing.

exercises.name: Step-Up
exercises.setup: Use a stable box around knee height or lower.
form_cues: Plant entire working foot on the box.
Drive through that leg rather than pushing strongly off the trailing foot.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.setup: Align machine knee pivot with your knee joint and pad above ankles.
form_cues: Extend knees smoothly.
Squeeze quads at top.
Lower under control without slamming the stack.

exercises.name: Sissy Squat
exercises.setup: Hold a stable support if needed and rise slightly onto the balls of the feet.
form_cues: Let knees travel forward as torso leans back in a straight line.
Use a small range at first and stop if knees feel painful.

exercises.name: Spanish Squat
exercises.setup: Anchor a strong band behind knees and step back until it supports you.
form_cues: Sit back while keeping shins relatively upright.
Keep torso tall and drive through the feet.

exercises.name: Wall Sit
exercises.setup: Slide down a wall until knees are near a comfortable bend.
form_cues: Keep full back supported and feet planted.
Hold without letting knees collapse inward.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl
exercises.setup: Align knees with machine pivot and pad just above heels.
form_cues: Curl heels toward glutes without lifting hips from pad.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.setup: Adjust knee pivot and thigh pad snugly.
form_cues: Curl heels down and back.
Keep hips against seat and control return.

exercises.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
exercises.setup: Secure ankles under a heavy fixed object or with a partner.
form_cues: Keep hips extended and body straight from knees to head.
Lower slowly using hamstrings and catch yourself with hands as needed.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
exercises.setup: Stand on one leg with a soft knee and hold weight in opposite or same hand.
form_cues: Hinge at the hip while rear leg extends behind.
Keep hips square and spine neutral.

exercises.name: Glute-Ham Raise
exercises.setup: Set knees slightly behind the pad and ankles secured.
form_cues: Lower torso under hamstring control while keeping hips extended.
Pull back up using hamstrings rather than bending at the waist.

exercises.name: Stability Ball Leg Curl
exercises.setup: Lie on back with heels on ball and hips lifted.
form_cues: Curl ball toward hips while keeping hips elevated.
Extend legs slowly without dropping the pelvis.

exercises.name: Slider Leg Curl
equipment: Sliders or towels on smooth floor
exercises.setup: Lie on back with heels on sliders and hips raised.
form_cues: Slide heels away and back while keeping hips elevated as much as possible.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.setup: Upper back rests on a stable bench. Roll padded bar over hips and plant feet around shoulder width.
form_cues: Tuck chin slightly.
Drive hips upward until torso is roughly parallel to floor.
Finish by squeezing glutes, not overextending low back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
exercises.setup: Place upper back on bench and dumbbell securely across hips.
form_cues: Drive through heels or midfoot.
Keep ribs down and squeeze glutes at the top.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.setup: Lie on back with knees bent and feet flat.
form_cues: Drive hips upward while keeping ribs down.
Stop when hips are fully extended without arching the back.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
exercises.setup: Lie on back with one foot planted and opposite leg raised.
form_cues: Drive through planted foot and keep hips level.
Avoid rotating the pelvis.

exercises.name: Cable Pull-Through
exercises.setup: Set cable low, face away, and straddle rope.
form_cues: Hinge hips back as rope passes between legs.
Drive hips forward to stand without leaning back.

exercises.name: Cable Kickback
exercises.setup: Attach ankle strap to low cable and hold support.
form_cues: Extend leg backward from the hip without arching the low back or rotating the pelvis.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction Machine
exercises.setup: Sit with pads outside knees and back supported.
form_cues: Press knees outward under control.
Avoid bouncing at end range.

exercises.name: Banded Lateral Walk
exercises.setup: Place mini band above knees or around ankles.
form_cues: Use a slight squat.
Step sideways while keeping toes forward and constant band tension.

exercises.name: Clamshell
exercises.setup: Lie on side with knees bent and hips stacked.
form_cues: Keep feet together while opening top knee.
Do not roll pelvis backward.

exercises.name: Frog Pump
exercises.setup: Lie on back with soles of feet together and knees opened outward.
form_cues: Drive hips up by squeezing glutes.
Keep range controlled and ribs down.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.setup: Stand on a stable platform with balls of feet supported and heels free.
form_cues: Lower heels under control, then rise as high as possible through the big toe.
Avoid bouncing.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
exercises.setup: Place balls of feet on platform with knees bent and pad over thighs.
form_cues: Lower heels deeply under control, then press up through toes.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
exercises.setup: Stand on one foot near support.
form_cues: Use full controlled range.
Keep ankle from rolling outward and press through the big toe.

exercises.name: Donkey Calf Raise
exercises.setup: Hinge torso forward with hips supported or use a donkey calf machine.
form_cues: Move only at ankles.
Lower heels and rise fully without bouncing.

exercises.name: Hip Adduction Machine
exercises.setup: Sit with pads inside knees and choose a comfortable starting width.
form_cues: Bring legs together smoothly.
Control the return and avoid forcing an extreme stretch.

exercises.name: Copenhagen Plank
exercises.setup: Lie sideways with top leg supported on a bench and forearm on floor.
form_cues: Lift hips so body is straight.
Keep top leg pressing into bench and avoid sagging.

exercises.name: Lateral Lunge
exercises.setup: Take a wide stance or step far to one side.
form_cues: Sit hips back over the working leg while other leg stays straighter.
Keep working foot flat.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.setup: Set forearms on floor with elbows under shoulders and legs extended.
form_cues: Squeeze glutes and brace abs.
Keep body straight and avoid letting hips sag or pike.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.setup: Lie on side with elbow under shoulder and legs stacked or staggered.
form_cues: Lift hips until body is straight.
Keep chest facing forward and do not rotate downward.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.setup: Lie on back with hips and knees at 90 degrees and arms toward ceiling.
form_cues: Press low back gently into floor.
Extend opposite arm and leg without losing trunk position.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
exercises.setup: Start on hands and knees.
form_cues: Extend opposite arm and leg while keeping hips square.
Avoid arching or rotating.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise
exercises.setup: Hang from a bar with shoulders active.
form_cues: Curl pelvis upward as knees rise.
Avoid swinging and control the lowering phase.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.setup: Hang from bar with legs straight or slightly bent.
form_cues: Raise legs while curling pelvis upward.
Use controlled motion and avoid momentum.

exercises.name: Captain's Chair Knee Raise
exercises.setup: Support forearms on pads with back against support.
form_cues: Raise knees by curling pelvis.
Do not just flex at the hips.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.setup: Kneel facing a high pulley with rope beside the head.
form_cues: Crunch ribs toward pelvis.
Keep hips relatively fixed and avoid pulling only with arms.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.setup: Kneel with wheel under shoulders.
form_cues: Brace and roll forward while keeping hips from sagging.
Reverse before losing spinal position.

exercises.name: Pallof Press
exercises.setup: Stand sideways to an anchored cable or band and hold handle at chest.
form_cues: Press arms forward without letting torso rotate toward the anchor.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
exercises.setup: Sit with torso leaned back slightly and spine tall.
form_cues: Rotate the ribcage side to side rather than just moving the hands.
Keep movement controlled.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunch
exercises.setup: Lie on back with hands lightly behind head.
form_cues: Rotate shoulder toward opposite knee while extending the other leg.
Do not pull on neck.

exercises.name: Reverse Crunch
exercises.setup: Lie on back with hips and knees bent.
form_cues: Curl pelvis off the floor by bringing knees toward chest.
Avoid swinging legs.

exercises.name: Hollow Body Hold
exercises.setup: Lie on back and press low back into floor.
form_cues: Lift shoulders and legs while maintaining low-back contact.
Bend knees if needed.

exercises.name: Mountain Climber
exercises.setup: Start in a high plank.
form_cues: Drive knees forward alternately while keeping hips relatively level.
Move faster only if trunk stays controlled.

exercises.name: Suitcase March
exercises.setup: Hold one heavy weight at your side and stand tall.
form_cues: March slowly without leaning.
Keep ribs stacked over pelvis.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing
exercises.setup: Set kettlebell a foot or two in front. Hinge and hike it back between legs.
form_cues: Snap hips forward to propel the bell.
Arms guide rather than lift.
Keep spine neutral and avoid squatting the swing.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Thruster
exercises.setup: Hold dumbbells at shoulders and stand in squat stance.
form_cues: Squat, then drive upward and use leg momentum to press overhead.
Finish with ribs controlled.

exercises.name: Barbell Thruster
exercises.setup: Hold bar in front rack position.
form_cues: Descend into front squat.
Drive up powerfully and transition into an overhead press.

exercises.name: Burpee
exercises.setup: Stand with room to move.
form_cues: Squat down, place hands, step or jump to plank, perform optional push-up, return feet forward, then stand or jump.
Keep landings controlled.

exercises.name: Bear Crawl
exercises.setup: Start on hands and feet with knees hovering just off the ground.
form_cues: Move opposite hand and foot together.
Keep hips low and trunk stable.

exercises.name: Sled Push
exercises.setup: Load sled and grip handles firmly.
form_cues: Lean forward from ankles, keep spine neutral, and drive short powerful steps through the floor.

exercises.name: Sled Pull
exercises.setup: Attach strap or grip handles securely.
form_cues: Walk backward or forward depending variation.
Keep torso controlled and maintain steady steps.

exercises.name: Battle Rope Waves
exercises.setup: Anchor ropes securely and hold one end in each hand.
form_cues: Create waves using quick arm motion while maintaining a soft-knee athletic stance and braced torso.

exercises.name: Medicine Ball Slam
exercises.setup: Use a non-bouncing slam ball in open space.
form_cues: Raise ball overhead without overextending.
Slam using trunk and arms, then pick it up with a squat or hinge.

exercises.name: Turkish Get-Up
exercises.setup: Lie on back holding weight vertically in one hand with same-side knee bent.
form_cues: Keep eyes on the weight initially.
Move through elbow, hand, bridge, kneel, then stand.
Reverse the sequence slowly.
Use light weight until technique is mastered.

exercises.name: Power Clean
exercises.setup: Start bar over midfoot with a clean grip. Hips above knees and shoulders slightly over bar.
form_cues: Push from floor, keep bar close, then extend hips and knees powerfully.
Pull under and catch on shoulders with knees bent.
This lift benefits from qualified coaching.

exercises.name: Hang Power Clean
exercises.setup: Start standing with bar at thighs, then hinge to a hang position above or below knees.
form_cues: Drive through hips and legs, keep bar close, and catch in a partial squat on the shoulders.

exercises.name: Clean and Jerk
exercises.setup: Perform a clean to the front rack, stand fully, then prepare for the jerk.
form_cues: Dip vertically, drive through legs, and punch under the bar to locked arms.
Recover under control.
Qualified coaching is strongly recommended.

exercises.name: Snatch
exercises.setup: Use a wide grip and start bar over midfoot with shoulders over bar.
form_cues: Keep bar close, extend explosively, and pull under into an overhead squat catch.
This is highly technical and should be learned with coaching.

exercises.name: Hang Power Snatch
exercises.setup: Start from a standing hang position with a wide snatch grip.
form_cues: Explode through hips and knees, keep bar close, then pull under to catch overhead in a partial squat.

exercises.name: Push Press
exercises.setup: Start bar in front rack position.
form_cues: Dip a few inches with torso upright, then drive through legs and press bar overhead.

exercises.name: Push Jerk
exercises.setup: Start in front rack.
form_cues: Dip and drive upward, then quickly re-bend knees to catch bar overhead before standing fully.

exercises.name: Pause Bench Press
exercises.setup: Set up like a standard bench press.
form_cues: Lower to chest and pause motionless for about 1 to 2 seconds without relaxing.
Press while maintaining tightness.

exercises.name: Tempo Squat
exercises.setup: Set up like a normal squat.
form_cues: Use a controlled prescribed descent, such as 3 seconds, then stand with normal or prescribed tempo.
Keep position consistent.

exercises.name: Paused Squat
exercises.setup: Use normal squat setup.
form_cues: Pause at the bottom without relaxing or bouncing.
Maintain bracing, then drive upward.

exercises.name: Block Pull
exercises.setup: Set bar on sturdy blocks around mid-shin to knee height.
form_cues: Brace and pull like a deadlift.
Keep bar close and avoid overextending at lockout.

exercises.name: Rack Pull
exercises.setup: Set safety pins at the desired height and place bar on them.
form_cues: Brace before pulling.
Stand tall with the bar close.
Do not slam the bar onto safeties.

exercises.name: Deficit Deadlift
exercises.setup: Stand on a stable low platform, usually 1 to 2 inches.
form_cues: Maintain normal deadlift positioning.
Use only a deficit that allows a neutral spine and strong start position.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.setup: Stand around shoulder width with toes slightly turned out.
form_cues: Sit down between hips.
Keep feet flat and knees tracking over toes.

exercises.name: Pistol Squat
exercises.setup: Stand on one leg with other leg extended forward.
form_cues: Sit down under control while keeping working foot planted.
Use support or a box until balance and strength are adequate.

exercises.name: Assisted Pistol Squat
exercises.setup: Hold a rack, strap, or doorframe lightly for balance.
form_cues: Use the support only as needed.
Keep knee tracking over toes and stand through the whole foot.

exercises.name: Dips
exercises.setup: Support body on parallel bars.
form_cues: Lower under control to a comfortable shoulder depth and press back up without swinging.

exercises.name: Muscle-Up
exercises.setup: Begin from a strong hang. A strict muscle-up requires a high pull followed by a transition over the bar or rings.
form_cues: Pull explosively with the bar close, transition chest over the support, then press out.
Build pull-ups and dips first and avoid uncontrolled kipping when learning.

exercises.name: Ring Row
exercises.setup: Set rings around waist height and lean back with body straight.
form_cues: Pull rings toward ribs while keeping shoulders down.
Adjust foot position to change difficulty.

exercises.name: Ring Push-Up
exercises.setup: Set rings low and assume push-up position.
form_cues: Keep rings stable and close to body.
Lower under control and press while preventing excessive wobble.

exercises.name: L-Sit
exercises.setup: Support body on straight arms with legs extended forward.
form_cues: Push shoulders down and lift legs using core and hip flexors.
Bend knees for an easier variation.

exercises.name: Handstand Hold
exercises.setup: Kick up against a wall or use a controlled freestanding entry.
form_cues: Push tall through shoulders, squeeze glutes, and keep ribs controlled.
Practice in a clear area.

exercises.name: Handstand Push-Up
exercises.setup: Start in a stable handstand against a wall or freestanding.
form_cues: Lower head between hands while elbows track naturally.
Press back to lockout.
Use partial range or pike push-ups first.

exercises.name: Pike Push-Up
exercises.setup: Start in an inverted V with hips high.
form_cues: Lower head toward the floor slightly in front of hands.
Keep elbows controlled and press back up.

exercises.name: Planche Lean
exercises.setup: Start in a push-up position with fingers spread.
form_cues: Lean shoulders forward past wrists while keeping elbows locked and body tight.
Use gradual loading to protect wrists.

exercises.name: Tuck Front Lever Hold
exercises.setup: Hang from a bar and pull shoulders down.
form_cues: Tuck knees toward chest and lift hips until torso approaches horizontal.
Keep arms straight and avoid swinging.

exercises.name: Skin the Cat
exercises.setup: Begin hanging with secure grip.
form_cues: Raise legs and rotate body through the arms into a controlled shoulder stretch, then reverse.
Use a small range initially and stop if shoulders feel strained.

exercises.name: Treadmill Run
exercises.setup: Set speed and incline appropriate to ability. Clip safety key if provided.
form_cues: Run with relaxed shoulders and short natural stride.
Land under the body rather than reaching far ahead.

exercises.name: Outdoor Run
exercises.setup: Choose a safe route and appropriate pace.
form_cues: Keep posture tall and relaxed.
Increase distance or intensity gradually.

exercises.name: Stationary Bike
exercises.setup: Adjust seat so knee remains slightly bent at the bottom of the pedal stroke.
form_cues: Pedal smoothly.
Avoid rocking hips side to side.

exercises.name: Rowing Machine
exercises.setup: Strap feet in and hold handle with straight wrists.
form_cues: Sequence each stroke as legs, body, arms.
Return as arms, body, legs.
Avoid opening the back too early.

exercises.name: Elliptical
exercises.setup: Step securely onto pedals and hold handles if needed.
form_cues: Use smooth strides and keep torso upright.
Avoid leaning heavily on handles.

exercises.name: Stair Climber
exercises.setup: Set a manageable speed and lightly hold rails if needed.
form_cues: Stand tall and place most of each foot on the step.
Avoid supporting bodyweight through the rails.

exercises.name: Jump Rope
exercises.setup: Use a rope length that clears the head and feet comfortably.
form_cues: Jump low on the balls of the feet.
Turn rope mostly from wrists and keep elbows near sides.

exercises.name: High Knees
exercises.setup: Stand tall with space to move.
form_cues: Drive knees upward quickly while keeping posture tall and landing softly.

exercises.name: Jumping Jacks
exercises.setup: Stand upright with arms at sides.
form_cues: Jump feet apart as arms rise overhead, then return.
Land softly and maintain rhythm.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.setup: Use a stable box at a conservative height.
form_cues: Swing arms and jump onto box with both feet.
Land softly with knees tracking over toes.
Step down rather than jumping down when possible.

exercises.name: Broad Jump
exercises.setup: Stand with feet around hip width and clear landing space.
form_cues: Load hips and swing arms, then jump forward.
Land softly with knees bent and balanced.

exercises.name: Skater Jump
exercises.setup: Stand on one leg and prepare to jump laterally.
form_cues: Leap side to side, landing softly on one foot.
Keep knee aligned with toes and torso controlled.

exercises.name: World's Greatest Stretch
exercises.setup: Start in a long lunge with hands near the front foot.
form_cues: Rotate the chest toward the front leg and reach upward.
Move slowly and do not force range.

exercises.name: 90/90 Hip Switch
exercises.setup: Sit with both knees bent around 90 degrees, one in front and one to side.
form_cues: Rotate knees from side to side while keeping torso as tall as possible.

exercises.name: Couch Stretch
exercises.setup: Place one knee near a wall with shin upward and opposite foot in front.
form_cues: Squeeze rear-leg glute and keep ribs down.
Increase torso height gradually.

exercises.name: Standing Quad Stretch
exercises.setup: Stand near support and grasp one ankle behind you.
form_cues: Keep knees close and pelvis neutral.
Do not yank the heel toward the glute.

exercises.name: Hamstring Stretch
exercises.setup: Place heel on a low surface or extend one leg while seated.
form_cues: Hinge from the hips with a neutral back until a gentle stretch is felt.

exercises.name: Calf Stretch
exercises.setup: Place hands on wall and step one foot back.
form_cues: Keep rear heel down and knee straight for gastrocnemius, or slightly bent for soleus.

exercises.name: Doorway Pec Stretch
exercises.setup: Place forearm on a doorway with elbow around shoulder height.
form_cues: Step forward gently until chest stretches.
Avoid forcing the shoulder backward.

exercises.name: Lat Stretch on Bench
exercises.setup: Kneel in front of bench and place elbows or hands on it.
form_cues: Sit hips back while dropping chest between arms.
Keep ribs controlled.

exercises.name: Thoracic Rotation
exercises.setup: Start on hands and knees or side-lying.
form_cues: Rotate through the upper back while keeping hips relatively still.

exercises.name: Ankle Dorsiflexion Rock
exercises.setup: Stand in split stance with front foot flat.
form_cues: Drive front knee over toes while heel stays down.
Move in a straight line with knee tracking toes.

exercises.name: Band Pull-Apart
exercises.setup: Hold a light band at shoulder height with arms straight.
form_cues: Pull band apart by moving shoulder blades back and down.
Avoid arching the lower back.

exercises.name: Scapular Push-Up
exercises.setup: Start in plank with elbows straight.
form_cues: Let shoulder blades move together slightly, then push floor away to spread them apart.
Do not bend elbows.

exercises.name: Scapular Pull-Up
exercises.setup: Hang with elbows straight.
form_cues: Pull shoulders down away from ears to lift body slightly.
Keep elbows locked.

exercises.name: Face Pull to External Rotation
exercises.setup: Set cable around face height.
form_cues: Pull toward face, then rotate hands upward while keeping elbows high but comfortable.
Use light weight.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Balance
exercises.setup: Stand near support on one foot.
form_cues: Keep tripod foot contact and knee softly bent.
Progress by reducing support or adding gentle movement.

exercises.name: Banded Terminal Knee Extension
exercises.setup: Anchor band behind knee and step back so knee begins slightly bent.
form_cues: Straighten knee by contracting quadriceps.
Keep foot planted and avoid snapping into hyperextension.

exercises.name: Tibialis Raise
exercises.setup: Lean back against a wall with heels on floor and feet slightly forward.
form_cues: Lift toes toward shins while heels remain planted.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Heel-Elevated Toe Raise
exercises.setup: Stand with heels on a small raised surface and toes free.
form_cues: Lift forefoot toward shins under control.
Use support for balance.

exercises.name: Hip Airplane
exercises.setup: Balance on one leg and hinge forward into a single-leg RDL position.
form_cues: Rotate pelvis open and closed slowly while keeping the stance foot stable.
Use support when learning.

exercises.name: Neck Flexion
exercises.setup: Lie on back with head supported or slightly off edge if appropriate.
form_cues: Gently tuck chin and flex neck through a small controlled range.
Use very light resistance.

exercises.name: Neck Extension
exercises.setup: Lie face down with head supported or use a dedicated neck machine.
form_cues: Extend through a small comfortable range.
Avoid jerking or loading heavily.

exercises.name: Neck Lateral Flexion
exercises.setup: Sit or lie with head neutral.
form_cues: Tilt ear toward shoulder through a controlled range without rotating the head.

exercises.name: Neutral-Grip Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.setup: Start dumbbells around shoulder level, seated or standing. Start with palms facing each other and elbows slightly forward.
form_cues: Press overhead while keeping ribs down.
Keep wrists over elbows and avoid excessive arching.
Keep palms facing inward throughout.
Press in a comfortable arc.

exercises.name: Pronated-Grip Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.setup: Start dumbbells around shoulder level, seated or standing. Start with palms facing forward and elbows slightly out.
form_cues: Press overhead while keeping ribs down.
Keep wrists over elbows and avoid excessive arching.
Maintain a palms-forward grip and avoid forcing elbows directly sideways.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.setup: Start dumbbells around shoulder level, seated or standing. Hold one dumbbell at the shoulder and keep the other arm free.
form_cues: Press overhead while keeping ribs down.
Keep wrists over elbows and avoid excessive arching.
Avoid leaning away from the working side.
Brace against rotation.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.setup: Start dumbbells around shoulder level, seated or standing. Set an upright bench to roughly 75 to 85 degrees.
form_cues: Press overhead while keeping ribs down.
Keep wrists over elbows and avoid excessive arching.
Keep your back against the pad and avoid flaring ribs.

exercises.name: Standing Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.setup: Start dumbbells around shoulder level, seated or standing. Stand with feet around hip width.
form_cues: Press overhead while keeping ribs down.
Keep wrists over elbows and avoid excessive arching.
Squeeze glutes and maintain a stacked ribcage.

exercises.name: Neutral-Grip Machine Shoulder Press
exercises.setup: Adjust seat so handles begin near shoulder height. Select the machine's parallel handles if available.
form_cues: Press overhead without shrugging excessively.

exercises.name: Pronated-Grip Machine Shoulder Press
exercises.setup: Adjust seat so handles begin near shoulder height. Select palms-forward handles if available.
form_cues: Press overhead without shrugging excessively.
Keep back against pad and control the return.
Press in the machine's intended arc without forcing shoulder range.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Machine Shoulder Press
exercises.setup: Adjust seat so handles begin near shoulder height. Use one handle at a time if the machine supports independent arms.
form_cues: Press overhead without shrugging excessively.
Keep back against pad and control the return.
Keep torso square against the pad.

exercises.name: Seated Barbell Overhead Press
exercises.setup: Start with bar at upper chest, wrists stacked, and feet about hip to shoulder width. Use a stable upright bench and rack with safety pins.
form_cues: Brace glutes and abs.
Move head slightly back as bar passes, then bring head through at lockout.

Press over the head while keeping the torso braced.

exercises.name: Behind-the-Neck Press
exercises.setup: Start with bar at upper chest, wrists stacked, and feet about hip to shoulder width. Use a very light bar and only if shoulder mobility comfortably permits the position.
form_cues: Brace glutes and abs.
Move head slightly back as bar passes, then bring head through at lockout.
Do not lean excessively backward.
Lower only to a comfortable depth.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Seated Cable Row
exercises.setup: Sit tall with knees slightly bent and handle attached to low cable. Attach a wide straight or multi-grip bar and grip outside shoulder width.
form_cues: Pull handle toward lower ribs.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Seated Cable Row
exercises.setup: Sit tall with knees slightly bent and handle attached to low cable. Attach a close neutral V-handle.
form_cues: Pull handle toward lower ribs.
Keep torso mostly still.
Do not over-reach by rounding the low back.

exercises.name: Neutral-Grip Seated Cable Row
exercises.setup: Sit tall with knees slightly bent and handle attached to low cable. Attach parallel-grip handles.
form_cues: Pull handle toward lower ribs.
Keep torso mostly still.
Do not over-reach by rounding the low back.

exercises.name: Underhand Seated Cable Row
exercises.setup: Sit tall with knees slightly bent and handle attached to low cable. Use a straight bar with palms facing up.
form_cues: Pull handle toward lower ribs.
Keep torso mostly still.
Do not over-reach by rounding the low back.

exercises.name: Overhand Seated Cable Row
exercises.setup: Sit tall with knees slightly bent and handle attached to low cable. Use a straight bar with palms down.
form_cues: Pull handle toward lower ribs.
Keep torso mostly still.
Do not over-reach by rounding the low back.
Row with a controlled elbow path and avoid shrugging.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Seated Cable Row
exercises.setup: Sit tall with knees slightly bent and handle attached to low cable. Attach a single D-handle.
form_cues: Pull handle toward lower ribs.
Keep torso mostly still.
Do not over-reach by rounding the low back.
Keep shoulders square and resist torso rotation.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Chest-Supported Machine Row
exercises.setup: Sit tall with knees slightly bent and handle attached to low cable. Adjust seat and use wide handles if available.
form_cues: Pull handle toward lower ribs.
Keep torso mostly still.
Do not over-reach by rounding the low back.
Pull elbows outward without hiking shoulders.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Chest-Supported Machine Row
exercises.setup: Sit tall with knees slightly bent and handle attached to low cable. Use the narrow parallel handles on a chest-supported row machine.
form_cues: Pull handle toward lower ribs.
Keep torso mostly still.
Do not over-reach by rounding the low back.
Pull elbows toward hips and keep chest on pad.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown

Bring bar toward upper chest.

exercises.name: Medium-Grip Lat Pulldown
exercises.setup: Adjust thigh pad snugly and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders. Grip slightly wider than shoulders.
form_cues: Pull elbows down toward the ribs.
Bring bar toward upper chest.

exercises.name: Neutral-Grip Lat Pulldown
exercises.setup: Adjust thigh pad snugly and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders. Use parallel handles on a multi-grip attachment.

exercises.name: Wide Neutral-Grip Lat Pulldown

exercises.name: Underhand Lat Pulldown

Bring bar toward upper chest.

exercises.name: Reverse-Grip Lat Pulldown

form_cues: Pull elbows down toward the ribs.
Bring bar toward upper chest.

Pull toward upper chest while keeping shoulders down.

exercises.name: MAG-Grip Lat Pulldown

exercises.name: Kneeling Lat Pulldown

exercises.name: Wide-Elbow Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
exercises.setup: Lie chest-down on an incline bench with dumbbells hanging beneath you. Use a pronated grip with elbows flared moderately.
form_cues: Pull elbows back and slightly out based on target.

exercises.name: Tucked-Elbow Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row

form_cues: Pull elbows back and slightly out based on target.

form_cues: Pedal smoothly.
Avoid rocking hips side to side.
Drive pedals and handles smoothly.

exercises.name: SkiErg
exercises.setup: Strap feet in and hold handle with straight wrists. Stand at ski erg with handles overhead.
form_cues: Sequence each stroke as legs, body, arms.
Return as arms, body, legs.
Avoid opening the back too early.
Pull handles down using lats and trunk while knees flex slightly.

exercises.name: Incline Treadmill Walk
exercises.setup: Set speed and incline appropriate to ability. Clip safety key if provided. Set incline and walking speed.
form_cues: Run with relaxed shoulders and short natural stride.
Land under the body rather than reaching far ahead.
Walk tall without holding rails excessively.

exercises.name: Backward Sled Drag
exercises.setup: Attach strap or grip handles securely. Attach sled straps and face sled.
form_cues: Walk backward or forward depending variation.
Keep torso controlled and maintain steady steps.
Walk backward in short steps with torso upright.

exercises.name: Weighted Step-Up
exercises.setup: Use a stable box around knee height or lower. Hold dumbbells and use stable box.
form_cues: Plant entire working foot on the box.
Drive through that leg rather than pushing strongly off the trailing foot.
Drive through working leg.

exercises.name: Deep Squat Hold
exercises.setup: Hold weight close to chest with both hands. Hold stable support if needed.
form_cues: Sit down between knees.
Keep chest tall, feet planted, and knees tracking with toes.
Breathe while maintaining foot contact.

exercises.name: Banded Shoulder Dislocate
exercises.setup: Stand with back or forearms against a wall. Use very light band with wide grip.
form_cues: Slide arms upward while keeping ribs controlled.
Reach slightly at the top without shrugging.
Move overhead only within pain-free range.

exercises.name: Cable External Rotation
exercises.setup: Set cable around elbow height. Keep elbow bent 90 degrees and pinned to side. Set cable at elbow height.
form_cues: Rotate forearm outward without letting elbow drift.
Use light resistance and controlled motion.
Rotate shoulder with elbow still.

exercises.name: Serratus Wall Slide
exercises.setup: Stand with back or forearms against a wall. Place forearms on wall with light band around wrists.
form_cues: Slide arms upward while keeping ribs controlled.
Reach slightly at the top without shrugging.
Slide up while gently pressing outward.
